article.title: Complaints against service providers.
article.content: Any person aggrieved by the functioning of 2[a service provider] may file a complaint to the Board in such form, within such time and in such manner as may be specified.
article.html:
2171[Complaints against service providers.]

Section 217 · Part IV · Chapter VI · page 137 of the Act

Any person aggrieved by the functioning of 2[a service provider] may file a complaint to the Board in such form, within such time and in such manner as may be specified.

1 Subs. by Act 6 of 2026, s. 63, for marginal heading (w.e.f. 26-05-2026).

2 Subs. by Act 6 of 2026, s. 63, for “an insolvency professional agency or insolvency professional or an information utility” (w.e.f. 26-05-2026).
